Dr Chris is called out to visit 42 year old Galah Pretty, who has a fast growing lump on his leg that is deeply concerning to owner Maurizio. Even though surgery on the old bird could kill it Maurizio is not keen on Chris’ alternative.
When miniature goat Monty enters the Bondi Clinic the vet nurses are all smitten until they discovery what the cute 4 week old is harboring on his skin!
Miniature Horse Charlie has a severe problem with his mouth that Chris needs to investigate, but getting access to the tiny creatures teeth becomes a near impossible task.

A Melbourne principal's staffy Juno is fading fast. Chris brings her to Sydney for a CT scan revealing a condition so rare only 20 cases exist worldwide—her blood vessels are all mixed up and she needs high-risk surgery.

Ziggy the cat has a big problem - he weighs almost a third more than he should. Chris needs to re-educate both the cat and the devoted owner to ensure the cats' deteriorating health is not compromised further.

Chris heads to Cornwall, UK. He's flat-out treating a dairy calf needing urgent surgery, a prize-winning duck with a torn foot, and a Siberian eagle owl with a bung eye, and giving two Atlantic grey seals the all-clear for release.

In an emotion charged episode, Chris is on a desperate rescue mission to save the life of a frail 3-day old orphan foal. Brulee has lost his mum and won't survive unless Chris can find him a surrogate. But it's no guarantee a mare will accept the little foal.

Chris meets a labradoodle with a chronic sneezing problem. 2 year old Lulu suffers massive sneezing fits up to 4 times a day, and her devoted owner Kim is desperate for help. Chris fears Lulu may have a tumor.
Chris heads to Abu Dhabi after a special invitation to visit an extraordinary veterinary hospital, where sick and injured falcons are treated like royalty.

A tiny kitten has been found abandoned in a cardboard box, and Chris is shocked at the extent of her injuries. She desperately needs surgery to try to repair her shattered leg. Then it's a heartwarming search to find her a new home.
Chris's trip has an unforgettable encounter with some of China's precious Giant Pandas. Chris is granted the rare privilege of hand feeding some youngsters.

Chris is confronted with an unusual patient, an albino echidna. But there's a question mark over whether the extremely rare echidna is a male or a female. It will have to be anesthetized so Chris can investigate.

Tiny Amari has been born with a badly twisted back leg. At just 3 days old she's one of the youngest kittens Chris has ever seen at the clinic. Amari needs a series of splints to try to save her leg, and give her a second chance.

Travel to the Cook Islands as Chris helps out at a vet clinic where ill and injured pets abound. Princess needs help following a hit and run, and Mani the duck has lost a fight. A goat and a wolfhound round out the medical menagerie.
Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much-loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing.

p.d: Colombia's Caribbean Highway cuts from coastal cities through mountains, rainforests and salt mines toward the Guajira Desert. Wind, sand and the encroaching sea regularly erode the road, forcing drivers to adapt as conditions shift along one of the country's most unstable routes.
The Bernina Express fights its way from Switzerland to Italy over 196 bridges and 55 tunnels. The path leads it through deep valleys, wild gorges and over the eternal ice of the Graubünden Alps.
Adventurer Francesca Chiorando travels to Sunny Beach Bulgaria to find out if it is a Holiday heaven...or Holiday hell.
The group jumps into unexplored territory: wingsuit flying on the coast of Sardinia. Also, Niccolo and Espen desperately want to try a new line which finishes on a beach.
Jokke Espen and Niccolo have emotional reunions with family members: first in the Alps, and later on the island of Sardinia-where Niccolo was raised.

Joseph faced temptation when no one else was watching and the way he responded is an example for how others should react when facing temptation.

Messianic-Jewish host Sid Roth features detailed interviews with his special guests who have personally experienced divine visitations, deliverance and other types of unique miracles in their own lives, exploring the supernatural.

Joseph Z's faith-filled journalism and Bible teaching for the Last Days will provide prophetic insights and predictions of global events, hoping to prepare the world to understand what's coming and what to do about it.
Josh explores the heart-pounding journeys into space. Apollo 13 astronauts fight to bring their malfunctioned spacecraft 238,000 miles back to Earth.
The loader fire forces a new reality, so Adrian revives an old fire truck as fallers fall big-money timber and road damage shuts down hauling.
Rob Nelson uses state-of-the-art technology to search for rumored escape tunnels deep beneath Alcatraz. Also, a mysterious pattern of rocks is investigated at the bottom of Lake Michigan.
Shane and Rusty position themselves for a once-in-a-lifetime deal, newcomers the Gold Drifters hunt for a long lost gold field, and Sheryl and Simon face the biggest decision of their mining careers.

Tony Beets fights the Yukon winter to build a monster dozer. Fred Lewis prospects a claim that could be too good to be true. Dustin Hurt tries to reach his remote mountain camp to determine if he'll be able to mine this season.

p.t: In The Eye Of The Storm: Chasers
p.d: Sarah holds her ground as Reed drives the Dominator inside a tornado. Gorilla hail bombards Freddy, and Brandon intercepts a tornado at a gas station.

Manufacturers give a behind-the-scenes look at the chart-topping, six-string star of rock and roll; the motorsports secrets to racing around the clock with a road car turned endurance racer; the popular seafood spread made from cod roe.
Seeking the truth behind sensationalistic stories, Josh investigates Jim Morrison's mysterious death, a mermaid-like creature and an alien abduction.

The Poseidon Crew are poised to secure ground that could hold multi-million-dollar nuggets, Jacqui and Andrew venture into north Queensland, and the Ferals take a gamble on a remote island expedition.

A disastrous fire could ruin the Gold Timers’ season before it has even begun. The Ferals are forced to launch a rescue mission when Rob goes missing.
Jacqui and Andrew are stranded in the dangerous tropical wilderness of the Palmer River region. Meanwhile, the Poseidon Crew face a critical meeting.
Winter storms ravage the Gold Retrievers’ new $35,000 dry blower and could end their season. Meanwhile, the pressure to find gold could tear the Ferals apart.

p.t: Kerouac's Road: The Beat of a Nation
p.d: Explores how the legacy of Jack Kerouac's iconic novel, On the Road, reflects in modern-day America, interweaving stories of on-the-roaders who share connections to Kerouac's life.
A nine-year-old boy experiences love, laughter, and loss as he comes of age amid the music and social tumult of the late 1960s.
While pursuing the most popular girl in school, an artsy outcast gets some help from his tomboy best friend, who has a crush of her own.

A man and his ex-wife race to Bali, Indonesia, to stop their daughter from marrying a seaweed farmer. As they desperately try to sabotage the wedding, the bickering duo soon find themselves falling for each other once more.

p.t: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
p.d: In 1979, young Donna falls in love and falls pregnant after university. In the present day, her daughter Sophie gets to know her mother's old friends and ex-partners as she renovates Donna's villa on the Greek island of Kalokairi.
Two sisters face romantic complications in the financially and socially motivated milieu of late 18th-century England.
Eight very different couples and their love lives intertwine during a hectic month before Christmas in London.
A bounty hunter learns that his next target is his ex-wife, a reporter working on a murder cover-up. Soon after their reunion, the duo find themselves on the run.
When a homeschooled girl finally attends high school, she befriends three popular students who are known to be cruel and manipulative.
Five high school students learn about themselves and one another when they are forced to spend a Saturday in detention.
A jilted newlywed whose wife has been unfaithful decides to start all over again with a waitress he knew at school.
When three best friends vow to get married within a year, each woman experiences her own difficulties getting to the altar.
Facing a crossroads in her life, a divorcee travels to Italy, India and Bali on a quest to change her life and find true happiness.
A widowed cleaning lady falls madly in love with a couture Dior dress and heads to Paris to buy one of her own.
An inexperienced student begins a daring affair with a controlling businessman, whose sexual proclivities push the boundaries of pain and pleasure.
Five high school students learn about themselves and one another when they are forced to spend a Saturday in detention.
A rude, drug-abusing educator vies with a perky colleague for the attentions of a rich and handsome substitute teacher.
When his beloved wife, Kathryn, is suspected of betraying the nation, intelligence agent George Woodhouse faces the ultimate test - loyalty to his marriage or his country.
A divorced couple teams up and goes to Bali to stop their daughter from making the same mistake they believe they made 25 years ago.
The IMF is shut down when it's implicated in the bombing of the Kremlin, causing Ethan Hunt and his new team to go rogue to clear their organisation's name.
Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating a highly skilled international rogue organisation that is committed to destroying the IMF.
When devoted lifeguard Mitch Buchannon butts heads with a new recruit, they must learn to put their differences aside after uncovering a criminal plot that threatens the future of the bay.
Forced into slavery by the corrupt heir to the throne, Roman general Maximus becomes a gladiator. His prowess in the arena leads him to Rome, the Colosseum, and a showdown with the new emperor.

Jason, Grant and the TAPS team head to New England to answer a call from a terrified family plagued by mysterious apparitions. During their investigation, TAPS uncovers some shocking evidence of paranormal activity in the home. From there, they take on claims at the Palace Theater in Manchester, NH, a former vaudeville stop.

The Taps team heads to the coasts to tackle with two investigations. First they travel to Massachusetts to visit the Colonial Inn at Cape Cod. Then they head over to California to investigate the Moss Beach Distillery.

Grant, Jason and the TAPS team head to New Jersey for their next investigation into the paranormal as they spend the night in the home of the last royal governor and look for evidence of hauntings before they examine the Red Mill Museum.

TAPS embarks on an investigation at Fort Delaware, built in the mid-1800?s and primarily used as an artillery defense for the Union during the Civil War. It eventually became a Civil War POW camp, housing over 33,000 Confederate soldiers. The conditions at Fort Delaware were grim, and it soon gained a reputation in the Confederacy as a ?black hole.?

A local preservation society took over this property in 2000, and discovered over 30 boxes of unclaimed human remains tucked away in the basement bathroom. Renovations unearthed remnants of the Episcopal church as well as light fixtures and stained glass that'd been hidden behind the walls and ceilings as if the original funeral director created a building within a building.

TAPS goes to Connecticut to unravel the mysteries at the historic Pettibone Tavern. Built in 1780, the tavern originally served as a carriage stop between Albany and Boston during the late 18th century. During this time, it was also supposedly the site of a brutal axe murder, and through the years, employees have consistently reported activity that they cannot explain.
TAPS visits a 16th century North Kingstown, R.I., landmark to solve an awful mystery. Then, TAPS comes to help a military family living in Groton, Conn.

TAPS visits the abandoned (and skeevy) remains of an art-deco masterpiece, Buffalo Central Terminal. The terminal, a 14-story combination office tower/train station, opened in 1929 and closed 50 years later. After falling through the hands of various owners, the Central Terminal Restoration Corp. acquired it in 1997. In the years since the Terminal's abandonment, it has become a potent source of paranormal stories.

TAPS is in Florida to investigate an inn that is a hotbed of paranormal activity. This unique St. Petersburg property consists of two multi-story Victorian manors: the Pink House and the Purple House. They were both built in the late 1800s, and are believed to house more than just customers.

Paranormal investigators Grant Wilson and Jason Hawes attempt to find evidence of supernatural activity at a plantation home where a tour group consisting of 35 visitors claim to have witnessed a candlestick flying across the room.

Heather Tracy and her family moved into her ancestor's property two years ago. There were always reports of odd activity and it soon became apparent to her that there was something more to the stories.

TAPS investigates a landmark pool hall in team member Steve Gonsalves' hometown. Over the years, the first floor fronted several retail clients, but is now a tavern called Theodore's. Though two separate establishments, Theodore's and Smith's have a common problem; they both experience intense paranormal activity. Now, their owners are working together and asking TAPS to diagnose their decades-old problem.

TAPS returns to investigate another legendary haunted naval landmark--the aircraft carrier USS Hornet in Alameda, CA. The Hornet, the eighth vessel to carry her name, was commissioned at the height of World War II in 1943. She quickly became one of the most highly decorated ships in the Navy and the USS Hornet is considered the most haunted ship in the Navy, past or present.
TAPS heads to Topsfield, Massachusetts to investigate an old haunted farmhouse.
Josh Gates hosts a roundtable discussion with the members of TAPS in the Soldiers’ Barracks of Fort Delaware.

There is more to you than meets the eye. You are a spirit being. You have a soul. You live in a physical body In this encouraging message, Pastor Bayless walks through three remarkable stories from Mark chapter 5 that reveal how Jesus brings freedom to the whole person. You’ll see how Christ delivers an oppressed soul, heals a broken body, and even restores life where all hope seemed lost. These stories remind us that no situation is beyond the reach of God’s power. Discover how coming to the feet of Jesus can change everything as you listen today.

p.t: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
p.d: In this interview Dr. David Jeremiah and Sheila Walsh discuss the enemies we face and the weapons we have as we fight, as well as the courage and strength God gives us while we battle.

Bruce Downes is The Catholic Guy. Bruce and his team will move, inspire and challenge you to live your life to the absolute fullest. No matter your age, situation or background, be prepared to laugh, learn and listen to what God is trying to say to you. Bruce travels Australia speaking regularly about his experiences in life and in the Church in a way that is both relatable and easy to understand. Bruce's message of power, impact, freedom and purpose is for anyone and everyone - for no matter where you are around the world today, God is never far from you.

Friends and Heroes is an animated children's adventure based in Ancient Egypt, Israel and Rome. The story follows two young friends Macky and Portia as they fight for justice against the Roman Empire.
Hillsong Kids has your favourite worship music for children and fun faith-based videos produced by the creative team behind Hillsong Kids Praise and Worship ...

Parable Playhouse is a collection of animated stories based on the Parables Jesus taught. Featuring characters from the popular, God Rocks! series, each episode shares an important faith lesson for kids. Parable Playhouse is great for family viewing and will spark meaningful discussion about the treasured stories Jesus shared with His followers.

Welcome to the wonderful world of Brightington, home of Hunter and Twerp, Scripture Seekers! Stacks of fun Bible lessons for children to enjoy. Every episode brings new challenges to overcome and new lessons to learn, such as why do we pray? What/who is the Holy Spirit? Why is the Bible important? How can we recognise the voice of God and avoid nonsense teaching? Challenging and powerful lessons are introduced in the context of wacky comedy adventures that children will love so much, they won't even realise they're learning!
Miles Peterson had everything: Money, power, fame...Until he lost it. Then Miles finds the power of God and harnesses that power to become Bibleman.

Freddy, David, Melissa and their friends find themselves navigating the rough waters of peer pressure, temptation, fear, forgiving others, listening to parents, dealing with bullies, lack of self-esteem, and so much more. Children can relate to these adorable characters and their problematic situations. Each action-packed, beautifully animated episode, shows the characters praying to Jesus, asking Him for guidance and wisdom. The Sea Kids will help transform the heart and mind of every child as they learn how to tangibly live out the biblical principles being taught while building a strong foundation in Jesus.

Whirl is a Bible-based cartoon series about the loveable, sometimes overly-enthusiastic kids of First Second Church. In each episode, the kids tackle a different theme that is central to Christian values. Everything from generosity and forgiveness to doubt and the trinity are explored over the course of the series. And while the issues dealt with in each episode are relatable, the solutions this kooky cast often find are a bit… unconventional. Whether the kids of First Second Church are searching for a hidden sanctum of the church's altar guild, or trying to outsmart robots bent on world domination, these characters will keep the whole family laughing and learning.

This quirky kids show introduces children to classic stories from the Old Testament using finger puppets. The Deditos series is produced in Guatemala by a multicultural team, it has a distinct international flavour which is ideal for children all around the world.

Get the best of both land and sea as Chef Spencer Watts creates fun surf and turf dishes featuring halibut and lobster.
Seafood enthusiast and Chef Spencer Watts shows how easy and incredibly delicious cooking a whole fish or shellfish can be as he makes snapper and crab.
Chef and seafood expert Spencer Watts shows how vinegar, a simple pantry staple, can bring out the flavours of walleye, lobster, and crawfish.
Fa-what? Fa-waffles! Desiree Nielsen cooks up protein-rich falafel waffles for breakfast.

Desiree Nielsen makes a tonic of oranges, carrots, pomegranates and mint from her garden, then she serves sweet potato hash with edamame and bok choy, next she combines warm grilled romaine with nutty barley and crispy halloumi to create a main dish.

Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from Your Pasta Sucks: A “Cookbook” by comedian Matteo Lane! Follow along as Shahir prepares eggplant parmigiana, pasta alla pesto trapenese, and risotto allo zafferano!
Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.

The team hunts for restless souls in a coal mine near a purported mass grave. After a series of paranormal experiments, they find out if a living man's visits are keeping a spirit attached to the mine.

The team studies the branches of a haunted family tree at Brennan House in Louisville, Kentucky, and learn why the successful childless clan always returned home to die—and if they've never really left.

Meet Richard Cirese, a mayor who’s deeply invested in the preservation of a town with a tragic past. Explore a nearby river and railroad tracks to see if they are responsible for paranormal activity that both locals and visitors have witnessed.
Discover new types of ghosts, like the one that saved Honey’s son’s life.
Get to know people who are too scared to go home thanks to ghosts.
See one spooky encounter in a graveyard and another near a temple of the dead.
Watch a couple speculate about the life of a judge who now haunts their home.
See how two women’s lives turned around when ghosts made them promises.

Leitreanna, a lifelong practitioner of Seminole spiritualism, believes that she was visited by her departed father as she endured an excruciating operation, seeing him comfort her when she was in blinding pain.

Susan has been wrestling with the untimely death of her brother and nephew for years and the phenomena Susan experienced prior to his passing almost seems to be a macabre foreshadowing to the torment she still feels because of his death.
After mending her relationship with her mum following a cancer diagnosis, Stacy believes a series of paranormal occurrences are a testament to the love they share, even beyond the grave.

Kaitlin, who ardently wished to see her mother after her passing, finally has that wish fulfilled, however she soon learned that this experience was only one leg of her family's strange paranormal journey, dating back to her childhood.
Brandon and Mustafa explore Waverly Hills Sanatorium with guide Hailie, whose lifelong fascination with the hospital deepened after discovering her great-grandmother's own connection to the building.

Corine, Leanne and Kelly search for answers in Massachusetts, uncovering what Salem's ghosts reveal about the infamous witch trials, before receiving a chilling message from a man executed in the most gruesome way imaginable.

Call out to the pirates who once ran this South Carolina port city. Make a fascinating discovery about a famed buccaneer hunter, relive a ghostly bedroom visit in an 18th-century tavern, then confront the gentleman spirit that keeps haunting Corine.

The first team to prepare 10 perfect plates of lobster ravioli gets to relax by the pool at a mansion in Beverly Hills while the other team cleans the kitchen; some contestants excel at delivering a steak dinner to diners and Ramsay berates the rest.

The red and blue teams test their memories when they must match side dishes with four different kinds of protein, and while the winners go to Laguna Beach, the losers prepare honey taffy; the contestants prepare breakfast for a wedding.

Each team picks a leader for the next dinner service, during which they will serve their first VIP guests, but one chef accidentally serves a dish before it is fully cooked; one team sends two chefs to Chef Ramsay for possible elimination.

Pairs from the teams create unique pizza dishes for a chance to win a relaxing day trip to a hotel; at dinner service, the chefs must impress Chef Ramsay's family, but while one team excels, the other runs out of a crucial ingredient.

It's up to the chefs to host the 160th anniversary party for the Phi Mu sorority, and after a southern-inspired menu for the social committee sends one team to Las Vegas, the teams run into communication issues during dinner service for the party.

Joy wonders why Kashia has made it this far in the competition, or even why she qualified for it in the first place, if she is unable to fry chicken; as the clock ticks down, the team members have to create entrees with surprise ingredients.

The contestants go on an unexpected field trip to a Gordon Ramsay restaurant so that they can see what they have to look forward to, then the teams prepare meals from the restaurant's menu, and while one excels, another struggles to communicate.

The team with the best knowledge of pork goes indoor sky-diving while the losing team prepares for dinner service, but while one team has a hard time dividing responsibilities, the other can't coordinate timing, leaving dinner service a disaster.

The contestants blindly choose ingredients in a dark grocery store and must create a dish that uses all of them; the contestants struggle to serve a five-course meal to VIP attendees, including UNICEF ambassador Angie Harmon.

Each team creates their own restaurant menu and presents sample dishes to Chef Ramsay, and at dinner service, guests are given the choice of which menu to order from with the most popular menu with the best service determining the winning team.

Chef Ramsay challenges the contestants to a blind taste test, and the team that identifies the most ingredients wins an ice skating lesson with an Olympian while the losing team makes ice cream; one team can't work together at dinner service.

The teams must purchase ingredients to produce an entrée with the highest dollar value under a small budget, and the winners go on a shopping spree while the losers clean; later, the chefs try to impress former winners with individual entrées.
Remaining contestants prepare dinner for guests from Oxfam America, including an Academy Award-nominated actress; tensions and struggles could lead to an early elimination.

The remaining six chefs prepare tailgate food for football fans at the University of Southern California and the chefs who earn the most votes go to a lunch and wine tasting in Malibu while the rest sort recycling; tempers rise at dinner service.
The chefs must create dishes using only leftover ingredients, and the winner has their dish featured in \.

p.d: The family of WW2 survivor Raymond Haerry travels 5,000 miles to return to Pearl Harbor to place their father's ashes back aboard the battleship.

p.d: The Louvre resumes the work of archaeologist Auguste Mariette at the Serapeum, enriching Egyptology's saga.
1968 was a year marked by assassinations, a contentious presidential election, an escalating anti-Vietnam War sentiment, and more.
Financing Evil: Who financed Hitler and helped him to achieve power? Here, follow the trail of money to the top and see the secret partnerships that underpinned the evil regime. Part 1 of 4.
The Nazi Economic Miracle: Germany, 1937. Hitler appears to be fulfilling his promise of returning Germany to prosperity—but there was a deeply sinister side to the recovery. Part 2 of 4.
The Business Of War: With help from large corporations inside and outside of Germany, the Nazis had conquered much of Europe—and even their victims would be turned into profit. Part 3 of 4.
The use of propaganda in Hitler's Nazi regime. The first episode examines the Fuehrer's fascination with propaganda, which began in the trenches of the First World War.
The decade of propaganda, impassioned speeches, newspaper articles, posters and campaigning that all led to one moment - Hitler being made Chancellor of Germany in January 1933.
As Hitler's ambitions spread beyond Germany, the world drew toward another great war. This one would be fought on many battlefields, but also for the hearts and minds of the people.

The Assyrians conquered an empire from the Persian Gulf to the Mediterranean Sea. They plundered the great city of Babylon, and enslaved the tribes of Israel. even Egyptian pharaohs paid them tribute. Their army was the largest, strongest, and cruelest yet seen.
Adolf Hitler became the triumphant host of European countries he would soon try to invade.

After his wife passed away, a man's home fell into disrepair when he closed off their bedroom, a part of an old addition that has no foundation or permits, and Mike rebuilds the space with work on a retaining wall, bathroom demo and asbestos removal.

p.t: Holmes 10th Anniversary Special: Behind The Overalls
p.d: Get a humorous, heartfelt look back at 10 years in the life of Canadaâ€™s favourite construction pro, Mike Holmes. See how his TV career began, find out what a typical Holmes crew day is like, and go behind the scenes of Mikeâ€™s best on-air moments.
A satellite dish installer accidentally uncovers a rotten roof. Mike and the team work to stretch Keith and Caitlin's repair budget, filling the gaps left by their previous inspection report.
First-time buyers Todd and Duane suspect their home inspector missed something major. Mike checks out their discovery and weighs whether fixing the blunder will derail their freshly decorated home.
A couple bought their two-storey historical home based on an inspector who found nothing wrong. Now that problems are emerging, they've sought help from Mike Holmes and his team.

A couple stays out of their much-loved, historical home for weeks while Damon and the crew repair problems Mike Holmes finds that the home inspector misses; a house has water coming into it, mold, holes in the foundation and dangerous fireplaces.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.

Mike eyes a promising live-work-play retreat in a tourist hotspot, but MJ's wary of the commute to this diamond in the rough. Meanwhile, water issues threaten to drain the budget at the Country House.
Things look up at the Country House as a partial second storey takes shape. But at the River House, dangerous structural issues force Mike and MJ's crew to tear down the roof and second-floor walls.

Mike and MJ face major structural and water issues at the river house and decide to take the whole thing down to rebuild it the correct way; at the country house, they continue to solve the water issues but soon notice more water on the ground.

A couple hired a contractor to build a wheelchair-accessible ramp in front of their house, but the ramp is not up to code and is a safety hazard, so renovation expert and host Mike Holmes comes to the rescue to rebuild the ramp.

Dig deep with homeowners Michelle and Jason, who have asked Mike for a bailout on their leaky basement. Check out the numerous patches that failed to fix the issue, then see the crew take it outside, where an excavation reveals the real problem.

A woman hired a contractor to remodel her garage, but all he did was take $20,000 and leave her with an ugly and flimsy space, so Mike Holmes arrives to transform the garage into a comfy studio where she can paint and relax.

Take a look at Julia’s basement redo, which went awry because the contractors didn’t do their due diligence with her new laminate floor. See Mike assess the encroaching mold, then get a lesson in under-floor heating and smart subflooring.

A couple has a troubling problem with their roof that is leaking and Mike is forced to demolish the existing roof in order to install a water-tight membrane to prevent any new leaks and then re-roof the entirety of the new house over the membrane.
A gun store robbery ignites a federal investigation into arson, violence, and murder. But soon the detectives come face-to-face with an unlikely killer.
For decades, a predator has been hunting in the shadows. Whispers of missing women, unsolved attacks, and a faceless monster haunt a quiet town.
A strange bond between an adulterous mother and her son leads to murder.
When a suburban husband and father's wife is found murdered, the police investigation reveals his secret double life as a BDSM devotee who is having an affair.

p.t: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace
p.d: The Barnetts, now divorced, abandon Natalia in an apartment in Indiana. When the police get involved, Michael's shocking confessions lead to their arrests.
Undercover officers target suspected meth and heroin dealers, including a dangerous gang member with a prior murder conviction.
Hashim's small-town fame inspires a local soccer team 'Hashim United.' One day, a friend's favour pulls him into a world he cannot escape.
After uncovering alleged new victims, Elizabeth Chambers is hot on the trail of convicted conman Anthony Strangis and ends up face-to-face with him.
A deadly home invasion claims the life of Washington Redskins safety Sean Taylor, shocking the league and exposing risks players face off the field.
When Shelley Nance is found stabbed to death, her murder sends the community of Lake Highlands into a panic. A bizarre fatal attraction is soon uncovered.

p.t: The Curious Case Of Natalia Grace
p.d: As Michael's trial approaches, he shifts fault to Kristine. He has a glimmer of hope when the judge throws out any discussion of Natalia's age during the trial.

p.d: At 16 years old, Terry helps Shaun murder Shaun's wife, Trisha Now, Terry seeks forgiveness from Trisha's family and redemption for his crime.

Jason experiences insecurity about challenges that the couple are quite literally dropped into. From falling out of the sky to a rappel into a dark cave will the couple be able to work together or will they end up stranded in the dark?

Sweet Migration serves up three unique stories, about: a family restaurant in Harbin serving a dish that's a unique fusion of southern and northern Chinese cuisines: a French bakery in Tierra del Fuego, Argentina; and a well-known donut shop in New York. As people move from city to city and country to country, they spread their culinary cultures. The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.
This episode focuses on the creation and inspiration of desserts.

The squirrel mandarinfish represents a clash between fish and sweet-sour flavors. In Macau's rosted apples, the combination of granulated sugar, cinnamon, and port wine elevates the dish with a sublime blend of sour and sweet.

From Teochew sweetrice cakes in China sugarcane in India to chocolate in Ivory Coast this episode tells the story of how humans pursue and obtain sweetness and how sweetness provides comfort and warmth to humanity.
In Lithuania, Chuck eats zeppelin dumplings, skates an indoor park, joins a Klezmer band, and cooks borscht in the bohemian Republic of Uzupis.
In Havana, Chuck eats pulled pork, visits the famous La Guarida, cooks rice and beans in a banana leaf, and signs the wall at a legendary mojito bar.
In Kingston, Chuck explores Rastafari Ital food, visits the Boston Jerk Center, catches river crayfish, and rafts to a rustic riverside restaurant.

Francesca is in the USA, in an area named The Bridgewater Triangle to discover if there’s any truth to its claim as the most paranormal area of the USA.

No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union. In Uzbekistan, the Aral Sea, once one of the largest freshwater lakes in the world, has seen its waters diverted, so that it has shrunk to 1/6 its previous size.

George explores the volcanoes of Costa Rica with an international team of scientists, rafts down whitewater rivers in full flood, canyoneers down raging waterfalls, and handles some of deadliest snakes this tropical country has to offer.

In this episode we explore the science of persuasion and discover that even a hardened sceptic can be convinced – Dr Jack himself included.
In this episode, Dr Jack Lewis investigates the neuroscience behind genius. He meets a genuine genius, Sabrina Chevannes, a woman with an IQ of 178 at just 4.
We explore the environmental consequences of war and how different people, from Rohingya refugees to Syrian scientists, are trying to restore a healthy relationship with nature.

Karin wants to separate her home from Jason's home-based personal training business.
Naima and Edo have outgrown her inherited family home. Jonathan and Drew help them decide whether to renovate a treasured property or move on.

p.t: Kirstie & Phil's Love It or List It
Kirstie & Phil's Love It or List It
Love It Or List It Australia

p.d: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koala's spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelle's slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

The pressure to find food reaches new heights and throws the reserve into turmoil. Witness fractures emerge within the ranks, dividing the gangs and leading Crystal, the indomitable leader of the Ruins gang, to face a challenge like none before.

Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the island's forests.

Yala National Park is an avian Eden, home to 215 species of bird. This paradise offers many possibilities for parents who can weather the ever-changing climate. Every species must either raise their offspring here or find a new home before the dry season ends and the monsoon storms begin.

Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the center's aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food. Then the rescue team works with the Ministry of Natural Resources to relocate a coyote that's too people-friendly.

This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

In South Africa's Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she's got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

In Brazil's Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.
In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing - water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It's a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

Winter has arrived but work continues apace at Hope for Wildlife. Look on as Hope rallies her team to release a herd of white-tailed deer that has been under her care. Investigate the possible causes of a mysterious influx of snowy owls to the rehab.

Marvel at the resilience of an orphaned joey, and then follow along as the team tries to help a two-year-old kelpie in danger of asphyxiation. There’s a dust-up in the dingo enclosure, and seven boisterous puppies arrive at the clinic.
Highlighting the unique and caring work performed at the rescue centre founded by Hope Swinimer, the arrival of spring heralds the final release of the deer back into the wild.

Emotions are running high at the clinic. Watch as Chris reunites with Poppy to search for a perfect foster home, helps a donkey facing a drastically diminished quality of life, and has his heart stolen by a homeless cat.

Join Chris at Victoria’s Kyabram Vet Clinic, where he helps a pregnant cow survive a difficult labour and saves a Maltese terrier’s unborn pups. Back in Sydney, Tim tries to assist a magnificent peregrine falcon that’s been grounded.

Get a first impression of Courtney, the new boarder, as Tammy and Allie grapple with managing the barn now that Megan has resigned. Tag along with Megan, who visits a friend in Alberta looking for greener pastures and a fresh start.

Brace for fallout as Tammy blows a gasket after Courtney is rude to Jamie and Alex. In Alberta, Megan isn't as lucky finding new employment as she'd hoped, and feels the stress as she finally decides to head home.
Size up a mastiff, a bulldog, and a Dobie with a family who wants a beefy pup.

The Golds Family is looking for a rescue dog to help teach their two young kids about responsibility and caring. They're visited by three great rescue dogs- a Labrador Retriever mix, a Beagle mix, and a German Shepherd mix.
The Higgins family wants a puppy that fits in with their active lifestyle.

Say hello to Tom, the youngest member of the Stoop family, who’s hoping to rescue a new canine companion. Hang out with two collie-Lab mixes and a shepherd cross and find out which sweet doggy finds a forever home by this young boy’s side.

“It doesn’t get much better than this” is one of the first things that Dr Chris says when a 4-week-old baby lion cub Zambi is brought into the Bondi Clinic. For safety reasons Zambi has had to be removed from her mother by carers Donna and Mandy from the animal welfare organization LOTL (Life On The Line) Rescue. Not only does the young lion require a medical check-up but she also needs a surrogate mother and Dr Chris has the perfect – while very strange solution. No one is sure if it will work.

Discover why an orphaned rhino’s eye infection has Rachel concerned. Head to the Eastern Cape, where vet Emily tries to get a dominant male sable antelope to stop bullying four young members of the herd, and review Emma’s caracal rehab plan.

Chris helps a beloved bunny with extreme heat stroke, and a routine checkup reveals a foster puppy needs open-heart surgery to survive. Can Chris also help three heron chicks and their mom find a more suitable home than a luxury boat?

See Chris rush to save Tasmanian devil babies in a reptile park and then return to the clinic in aid of a huge Newfoundland that has eaten something it shouldn’t. Another dog arrives at Sash emergency, having chomped on a poisonous pufferfish.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Jamie and Adam tackle exploding houses, dig deep into an old figure of speech, and find out just what it takes to get your garden up and jumping.

In this power-crazed episode, Adam and Jamie pit themselves against the law of gravity as they try to launch Buster into space - with fireworks. And in the myth of free energy they're up against all the known laws of science as they attempt to build a perpetual motion machine. Meanwhile the build team embark on a ghoulish myth that will turn your head, and Kari's stomach - the Killer Fan.
The Mythbusters begin this episode by once again taking aim at a classic movie myth. Can you really be Blown Away in a gunfight?

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie go head to head in a madcap Mexican jailbreak jaunt. And brace yourselves for the biggest bang ever on Mythbusters - by a mile - when Adam, Jamie and 850 pounds of high explosive join forces with the FBI to wreak their revenge on a stubborn cement truck.
In the myth a car breaks its drive shaft at the front universal joint. The drive shaft drops into a pothole and lifts the car into the air – much like a pole vault.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie try a test with a ton of toast, the build team head up a myth that’s one big yawn, and the whole gang decamp to Lake Tahoe for the most mismatched motor car race of all time.

This episode of MythBusters answers three diverse questions. Those with an eye for history will learn whether or not a crude form of battery was invented more than 2000 years ago. Those interested in technology will learn how to rebuild a crash test dummy. And everybody else will learn the fastest way to cool a six-pack of beer.

Myths tested: Could using a phone in a thunderstorm result in being electrocuted? Could a bullet pass through a man's genitals, into a woman's abdomen, and make the woman pregnant? Can a boat be driven with its trailer still attached?

The build team are testing out a story that could bring every household to its knees! Can the humble vacuum cleaner beloved by housewives and husbands for over 100 years, be turned into something altogether more terrifying?

In this twin-taled episode, Adam and Jamie embark on the longest and most ambitious build ever undertaken on Mythbusters. The sky is literally the limit as they aim to take wing on their own personal flying machine, which they knock up from scratch in the workshop. Meanwhile, Kari, Tory and Scotty subject an ancient myth to some modern testing - do pyramids have mystical powers of preservation?
Myth has it that when your plane's going down and the flight attendant tells you to assume the brace position, it's not to save you...it's to kill you!

In this special episode, the Mythbusters get into the festive spirit. They tackle a series of brand new Christmas myths, and in a first for the program, re-show the viewers' all time favourite experiments, as voted for on the Discovery Channel website.

In this episode of Mythbusters, Adam and Jamie hurl themselves headlong into a crazy contemporary myth, and bag a world record into the bargain. With nothing less than the very security of America's borders at stake, they dedicate an entire show to a myth which involves one of their biggest ever builds.

In this episode of MythBusters, Jamie and Adam tackle yet another automotive myth head-on and we mean head-on. They’ve got a car, Buster and a box of tissues. Sounds like a recipe for disaster. In the episode’s other story, the build team try to bust a myth from the middle ages, using an arrow-firing robot. It’s just another day in the MythBusters’ madhouse.

In this episode of MythBusters, Jamie, Adam and the team are in aviation heaven with three tall tales of high flying and free falling. The first pits them against Hollywood logic with Buster doing his best Indiana Jones impression. The second tests the explosive properties and decapitation potential of Hair Cream. And the third is about surviving a fall from 33,000 feet without a parachute.
See how flora and fauna work together to survive Table Mountain’s harsh climate.
Africa is a tapestry of habitats that host an incredible variety of creatures and within the mighty continent are areas of exceptional natural beauty - the Great Parks of Africa.
All these little connections form a complex and diverse network of plants and animals and it's this that makes the Luangwa Valley one of the most magical wildernesses in Africa.

It’s a first at forest school. Inside the clinic, the team meets a mysterious new creature. It turns out to be a sun bear - the tiniest of all bears! Find out how Denny Bear fares in these new surroundings.
The clinic deals with the aftermath of a Brisbane flood, while a baby kangaroo is in need of round-the-clock care. Vet Karina tackles the turtle waiting list.

A once-in-a-generation drought has sucked all the moisture from surrounding rivers and the conservation team is struggling to keep up with the swath of thirsty creatures. While some animals succumb to dehydration, the team must concentrate its efforts on a particularly vulnerable - and dangerous - water buffalo.
Follow the incredible journey of a Hawksbill turtle between two distinct worlds.
A colony of cape fur seal pups fights for survival on the coast of South Africa.
The ecosystem is a productive arena, primed with life. Its plenty relies on the delicate balance of its environments. Forest, reef and swamp all depend on each other to thrive.
See how cheetah mothers teach their fragile cubs the dangerous art of survival.
Nunavik, meaning 'Great Land', is bigger than California. It is a pristine wilderness of water, forest, and tundra, and home to the Inuit of Northern Quebec.
On the north-east coast of Baffin Island, in Canada's Arctic, lies Ninginganiq, a blustery wilderness where only the intrepid travel.
Follow cheetah cubs through the seasons and watch how, hunt by hunt, lesson by lesson, the once-vulnerable cubs grow into adolescence.
The Mesoamerican Reef is the second-longest barrier reef in the worl. It is a pristine ocean ecosystem - but after decades of overfishing and tourist activity, much of this reef is in jeopardy.

Eco-tourism isn't just a background player in the operation of Ol Pejeta, it's the financial backbone that keeps the park operating. From comfortable camping to ultra-luxurious accommodation, the guests that stay at Ol Pejeta live among nature during their stay and they even assist in research and tracking park wildlife.

The members of the SG-1 are shocked to discover that the Stargate has been stolen from the command center by a mysterious beam, and it is soon discovered that The Trust is plotting to poison their enemies with the use of an advanced ship.
A duplicate of Colonel Carter seeks help from Stargate Command in defeating the Replicator Fifth.

General Hammond and Daniel go on an expedition on the Prometheus to Atlantis. They encounter an abandoned Goa'uld Al'kesh and decide to salvage it. A Kull warrior rings aboard the ship and rings everyone else onto the Al'kesh leaving only Daniel onboard the Prometheus. The Kull warrior turns out to be a woman named Vala who wants to use Prometheus to evacuate her people from a Goa'uld occupied world. But is she telling the truth?
SG-1 arrives at Harry Maybourne's planet to find that he has been appointed king of a primitive people.
Relations are strained between the US government and Russia, Colonel Chekov pays a visit to General O'Neill with bad news, and security has been compromised.

Jack is shocked when a person he can't remember having ever met invades his home and makes outrageous claims about having his life ruined by his target, in addition to the alarming revelation that he knows all of the Stargate secrets.

Teal'c and Bra'tac believe the time is right to lead their people in an uprising against the Goa'uld. Their plan suffers a setback when an army of Replicators begins to systematically take control of Goa'uld ships and Jackson is taken prisoner.
The Jaffa Resistance assembles an army to retake a holy city. Plus, Baal seeks help from Earth when he is faced with a threat common to both parties.

After apparently dying, Daniel is surprised to find himself trapped inside the confines of a mysterious diner that is filled with fellow Ascendants; Anubis takes advantage of an opportunity to scheme on complete conquests of the galaxy.

SG-1 and O'Neill utilise the time-puddle jumper to go to Ancient Egypt to recover a ZPM. When they return they discover that the future has been altered and SG-1 never existed. Meanwhile, archaeologists find the video camera Daniel took with them to Ancient Egypt with instructions to find the Stargate, track down Teal'c, and return to the past in order to correct the future.

The alternate SG-1 go to Chulak to find Teal'c and Daniel is killed. The alternate Carter, O'Neill, and Teal'c then go back to ancient Egypt to correct the past. They meet the original timeline Daniel who is the only survivor of a failed rebellion against Ra. Together, they must formulate a plan to steal the Stargate so that Ra can not take it with him.

Lieutenant Colonel Cameron Mitchell, the newest member of the SG-1 team, sets out on a mission with Daniel Jackson, Teal'c and Vala to uncover a stash of hidden ancient riches. Ben Browder, Michael Shanks, Amanda Tapping, and Christopher Judge star.
Still bound together by the Jaffa bracelets, Daniel Jackson and Vala are transported to a galaxy populated by worshippers of a strange authority.

Daniel and Vala discover that the reactivation of an ancient communications device has inadvertently resulted in Earth being exposed to a group of deities who are completely unforgiving toward those unwilling to change their beliefs.

After an hour's separation from Daniel, Vala returns to SGC. Although the bracelets have been removed, their effects have not diminished. To break the link, Mitchell, Jackson, and Teal'c must deal with many people that Vala has used over the years.

A wealthy party boy is killed and the suspect may be a victim of his best friend's wild ways.
The fate of the task force is at stake when a meeting with Robert Silas goes sideways; with danger closing in, Bell and Stabler take creative measures to keep their team alive.

When an informant comes to Stabler desperate for help, the task force sets their sights on a dangerous gang making their mark on New York; Jamie goes undercover, but soon realises he may be in over his head; Bell meets her new boss.
Detectives Stabler and Benson find themselves in unfamiliar territory when Doctor Massey calls them in to investigate the case of a baby infected with AIDS.
On the season finale, Wicked Pissah, and Fat Tuna battle it out for the top spot.

After a stellar North Atlantic fishing season, some of New England's best bluefin tuna fishermen head south again to North Carolina's famed Outer Banks in their quest to bank big money. But they'll face some serious competition from the local southern fleet, especially from local fishing legend Charlie Griffin, captain of Reels of Fortune. Captain Dave Marciano of Hard Merchandise, Captain Tyler McLaughlin of Pinwheel and Captain TJ Ott of Hot Tuna all made good money during their fishing season up north, but now they're putting it all on the line by making the expensive journey down south and gambling their profits in the hope they'll be able to continue their catching streak. The challenging winter conditions in the Outer Banks make it one of the hardest places to catch bluefin tuna, and, within the first three days on the water, two boats will fall victim to the dangers here.

The treacherous Oregon Inlet, part of the aptly nicknamed Graveyard of the Atlantic in North Carolina's Outer Banks fishing grounds, becomes the site of two boat crashes. Northern vessel Hard Merchandise and the fleet's current leader Reels of Fortune take hard hits, sustain heavy damage and put survival suits to the test. Could this be the end of the season for both Bleufin tuna boats? While out in deep water the rest of the fleet is infiltrated by a surprising new addition -? the big-?talking, all-? female crew of Reel Action, captained by 17-?year veteran fisherwoman, Tami Gray. Will Reel Action usurp the leader or will Fishin' Frenzy, Pin Wheel or Hot Tuna take command of the seas?

When Charlie picks up his boat after mechanics have finished working on the damage, it comes with a 10,000 bill, so now he and his hard-working son Jake must catch that much in fish just to break even. After two back-to-back seasons of being runner-up in New England and North Carolina, confident and cocky young Captain Tyler McLaughlin is determined to finish out the season as the top boat.

At the start of day nine on the water, last season's champion, captain Greg Mayer and his Fishin' Frenzy crew are the top earners the Outer Banks' Bluefin tuna fleet. But their lead is only a slim margin over local rivals Charlie and Jake Griffin, of father-and-son operation Reels of Fortune. The Griffin boys, with a $10,000 boat repair bill still hanging over their heads, are more desperate than ever for a payday. Meanwhile, Captain TJ Ott, of northern boat Hot tuna, is looking for any advantage he can get to turn his mediocre season around, so he reaches out to southern Captain Tami Gray, of all-female team Reel Action, hoping that a new friendship will lead to a wealth of local knowledge. And on Doghouse, Captain Britton Shackelford's chances of landing his second keeper tuna of the season will all come down to whether his greenhorn son Austin can come through in a dangerous situation.

Eleven days into North Carolina's Bluefin tuna season, treacherous winter weather in the Outer Banks fishing grounds forces captains to push their limits. Southern boat Reels of Fortune holds a meager lead over last year's local champion Fishin' Frenzy, while northern boat Hard Merchandise and local all-female team Reel Action have yet to catch a fish.
A crewmember faces a family emergency unfolding on land that tests his resolve on the water.

Charlie Griffin, captain of family operation Reels of Fortune, and Greg Mayer, skipper of last season's top?earning boat Fishin' Frenzy, are neck and neck in the competition for the number one spot in the fleet. Meanwhile struggling Northern vessels Hot Tuna, who has caught only one bluefin so far, and Hard Merchandise, who have yet to land their first fish in southern waters, are desperate to make a paycheck in the Outer Banks. But soon one Northern boat will harvest the biggest fish so far this season.

With less than two weeks left in the North Carolina's Outer Banks Bluefin tuna season, time is disappearing for the fleet, and so are the fish. The captains and their crews are desperate for some final catches, but with the Bluefin starting their annual migration to other waters, these last few days of fishing will be make-or-break.

In North Carolina, the Outer Banks Bluefin tuna fishing season will soon be coming to a close. Southern boats Reels of Fortune, Fishin' Frenzy and Doghouse have emerged as the frontrunners this season. Northern vessels Hot Tuna and Pinwheel, and local all-female trio Reel Action have all struggled to catch and languish far behind on the leaderboard. Now, with only five days left to fish, the pressure is palpable, pitting boat against boat and on one troubled vessel, captain against crew.

With only two days of fishing left in North Carolina's Outer Banks Bluefin tuna season, southern boats Reels of Fortune and Fishin' Frenzy are running neck-and-neck for the top spot, with less than $200 separating the two rivals. However, one or two good Bluefin could also catapult fellow local boat Doghouse to the top of the leaderboard. Meanwhile, with only two fish each for northern boats Hot Tuna and Pinwheel, and only one fish for southern female trio Reel Action, these three boats are desperate for a final paycheck before the season closes.
The bluefin tuna arrive in North Carolina's treacherous Outer Banks much earlier than expected, leaving the fleet scrambling to get on the water.
As the new season takes off, the treacherous waters of the Outer Banks, known as the Graveyard of the Atlantic, claim more victims.

It's early in the Outer Banks bluefin tuna season, but it's already obvious that even an experienced fisherman might not have what it takes to survive in this hyper-competitive fishery. The animosity between southern and northern boats reaches a fever pitch, while the longstanding rivalry between two southern boats raises the stakes for the whole fleet.
An underdog captain takes a stand against the cocky reigning champion who underestimates him, forcing the fleet to take notice.
